promise: NEW YORKERS is sold in named releases. Nothing is ever added to a release once it closes, and no New Yorker is ever sold twice. Most releases are sized and closed before they open. KEYSTONE is the exception and says so on its face: it is open ended by design, it stands at 111 today, and it grows as new Keystone New Yorkers are made. The census is still being made, so more releases will follow, and every one is announced in advance, the same way.
promiseShort: Sold in named releases, and no New Yorker sold twice. Most are closed before they open. KEYSTONE is open ended and says so.
expansion: This is an evolving series. New eras are still being made, and the city keeps nominating people who are not in it yet. When a release is announced it says exactly what is in it, how many, in what format, on what platform and when. Nothing is ever quietly added to something you already bought into.
note: Two releases are open. THE CENSUS RELEASE is minting now on OpenSea and closes Saturday November 7, 11:11 AM ET. KEYSTONE is open on Transient Labs with no closing date. Prices below are what each release actually opened at.

releases.name: THE MARKS
releases.drawnFrom: 150 of the uncounted: New Yorkers who were made, numbered and then left off the count when THE CENSUS RELEASE was cut to 1,111. Plus nine era closers, the last number made in an era.
releases.subseries: The uncounted and the era closers
releases.format: Ones of one. The 150 mint at 0.069 ETH in an order shuffled once before the drop and published; every Mark is revealed the moment it is minted. The nine era closers are separate one of ones at 0.269 ETH.
releases.detail: Until October 9 this release was the hundred marks and the era closers. It now holds 150 of the uncounted and the nine era closers that are not already in KEYSTONE. The hundred marks left it unsold and are held for a later named release. The mint order was shuffled once before the drop with a published seed and a named Ethereum block, so nobody, the artist included, picks who gets which. The first 25 Marks are held in the artist's own wallet: ten minted before the mint opened, fifteen more on October 28. Nothing is added after it closes.
releases.price: 0.069 ETH on SuperRare, revealed the moment it is minted. The nine era closers are separate one of ones at 0.269 ETH, no reserve, no bidding.

releases.name: KEYSTONE
releases.countNote: 111 and counting. This release grows as new Keystone New Yorkers are made.
releases.onChainNote: All 111 are on chain. Each piece is collected on its own from the NEW YORKERS collection on Transient Labs, and every token carries its stack of versions: painted alternates, glitch and motion loops, dithers and ten artist restyles.
releases.drawnFrom: The founding NEW YORKERS: the Era I leads, the Mythos spine and the threads that hold the census together. The first 111 are the ones the whole city is built on.
releases.format: Dynamic ones of one on Transient Labs ERC-7160TL. The token holds a stack of finished states, the artist appends variants and new art over time, and the owner pins the one that shows.
releases.when: Open now. Pieces are collected one by one on Transient Labs.
releases.detail: This release replaces THE ONES and merges it in. THE ONES was published as 150 pieces in fifteen monthly chapters on SuperRare with a rising price ladder. That structure is gone. KEYSTONE is one open release on one contract at one price, and it is the only release here that is not sized and closed before it opens. Every piece is unique, one owner each, and because the contract is ERC-7160 the art inside a piece keeps growing after you own it. Nothing already made is ever deleted, and no New Yorker in this release appears in THE CENSUS RELEASE.
releases.price: 0.069 ETH each. One price, no ladder.

releases.name: THE CENSUS RELEASE
releases.drawnFrom: Drawn across eras II to XIX so no era is emptied, with every family, every borough and every set represented, and excluding the hundred and fifty in THE ONES.
releases.format: THE CENSUS RELEASE mints on OpenSea as ERC-721 tokens that are dynamic by metadata. Each token carries a stack of finished states in its own viewer, and the artist appends new states on Fridays.
releases.when: Open now. Closes Saturday November 7, 11:11 AM ET.
releases.detail: Era I is excluded because it paints real public figures. Pieces promised back to the people who nominated them are excluded, and so is every piece in THE ONES. Nothing in this release is ever reopened or topped up.
releases.price: 0.0042 ETH a piece, about $11 when it opened, in one public window, extended once, from 23 September to 7 November.

future.headline: More will follow
future.body: The census is not finished and was never meant to be. Eras are still being made, nominations arrive every week, and one is chosen every Sunday. Work that is not in a named release is not for sale yet, and it is not being held back forever either. It is simply not its turn.
